comment: Replaces skerry_reach_verify_solo.json (retired 2026-08-06, PLAN-metalstorm-wars.md §7.6). skerry_reach is the worst map in the imported set: 19% VEH-passable, and its EIGHT start positions land in EIGHT separate connected components, so nothing that spawns there can reach anything else. techno_lands_final_2.60_wide is the opposite and is the right target for a solo terrain/render check: 100% passable, one component, 4 starts. No scenario — this manifest boots the game_start stub force on purpose, so it stays useful for map/render verification independent of any war content.
name: dev:techno-lands-verify-solo
